Item 1. Security and Issuer

This statement on Schedule 13D relates to the common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of SmallCap Industries Inc., a Delaware corporation. The principal executive offices of the Issuer are located at 100 Main Street, Austin, Texas.

Item 2. Identity and Background

This statement is filed by Activist Capital LP, a Delaware limited partnership. The principal business of the Reporting Person is investing in securities.

Item 3. Source and Amount of Funds or Other Consideration

The Reporting Person expended approximately $18,400,000 in the aggregate to purchase the shares reported herein, funded from working capital.

Item 4. Purpose of Transaction

The Reporting Person acquired the shares because it believes the shares are undervalued. The Reporting Person intends to engage in discussions with the Issuer's board of directors regarding strategic alternatives, including a potential sale of the company, and may seek board representation at the next annual meeting.

Item 5. Interest in Securities of the Issuer

The Reporting Person beneficially owns 2,450,000 shares, representing approximately 8.2% of the outstanding common stock.

Item 6. Contracts, Arrangements, Understandings or Relationships

Other than as described herein, there are no contracts or arrangements between the Reporting Person and any other person with respect to securities of the Issuer.

Item 7. Material to be Filed as Exhibits

Exhibit 99.1 — Letter to the Board of Directors.
